text.en: Gen2 is row 87 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Diffusion Model Application area.
text.zh: Gen2 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 87 行，所属领域为“扩散模型应用”。

text.en: The annual table leaves the publication field blank for Gen2.
text.zh: 年度表中 Gen2 的论文标题字段为空。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is blank.
Runway's official Gen-2 research page is bylined by Anastasis Germanidis, while BenchCouncil's contributor field for Gen2 is blank.
text.zh: Runway 官方 Gen-2 研究页面署名 Anastasis Germanidis，而 BenchCouncil 的 Gen2 人物字段为空。

text.en: The official page presents eight modes: text to video, text plus image to video, image to video, stylization, storyboard, mask, render and customization.
text.zh: 官方页面展示八种模式：文生视频、文本加图像生成视频、图生视频、风格化、故事板、遮罩、渲染与定制。

text.en: Runway reports that users preferred Gen-2 results 73.53% of the time over Stable Diffusion 1.5 and 88.24% over Text2Live in the comparisons shown on its page.
text.zh: Runway 在页面展示的对比中自报：用户相较 Stable Diffusion 1.5 有 73.53% 的情况偏好 Gen-2，相较 Text2Live 的偏好比例为 88.24%。

text.en: Gen-2 was presented with text, image and video-conditioned generation modes.
text.zh: Gen-2 发布时展示了文本、图像与视频条件生成模式。

text.en: The public page includes modes that preserve source-video structure while changing visual content or style.
text.zh: 公开页面包含保留源视频结构、同时改变视觉内容或风格的模式。
